utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help load up or check the list—what do you need most for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. A hand loading up would help most—I’m still getting my bearings, so checking the list together would be a relief too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m on it—I'll help load up first, then we can check the list together.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but we should make sure the repair drive has a clear drop-off plan and enough people to sort everything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure we’ve got the drop-off plan covered, and enough people to sort it all?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not sure yet, so I’d rather confirm the drop-off spot and who’s sorting before we collect anything. If we’re short on people, we should ask for a few more volunteers now.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m a bit out of the loop, but I can take a look and see what I missed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Noah — I really appreciate it. I think there were a few repair items, but I’m a bit fuzzy on the details too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’ll check what was posted and get back to you with the details. Sorry, I’ve been a little scattered lately.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll mention the repair drive plans to a few neighbors and keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll spread the word and let you know if I hear anyone interested.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late — I heard there’s a repair drive going on. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries — if you’ve got a drill, a few screwdrivers, and maybe some work gloves, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ve got the drill and gloves, and I can grab a couple screwdrivers too. I’ll head over now.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—just let me know the plan and I’ll stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll send you the details and invite the rest of the neighbors too. Thanks for jumping in!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Quinn — send me the details when you have them, and I’ll follow along.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Sam, are we still on for the repair drive today?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, I’m still in for the repair drive today. What time do you want me to meet you?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How about 3 PM at the community hall?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help link folks up for the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — I need the repair drive location and the best way to get there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s at the community center on Maple, and the easiest way is to take the bus to 3rd Street, then walk two blocks east.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m glad we’re doing the repair drive—what do you need me to help with first?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — could you start by helping me list the biggest repair needs and who’s available to pitch in? That’ll help us organize the drive quickly.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll start listing the biggest repair needs and check who’s available to help. If you want, I can bring you a quick first draft soon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a quick tally of what we still need for the repair drive. Tell me what’s already covered, and I’ll note the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m not sure yet — I need the list first. What’s already covered?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’ve already got some tools and a few hands lined up, but I still need the full list to mark what’s missing. Send me what you know, and I’ll sort the rest.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are still dropping things off this afternoon, and it’s been a really nice turnout.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that’s good to hear. I might stop by later and see if they still need anything.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be great—last I heard, they could still use a few extra hands and maybe some tape or boxes. If you swing by, I bet they’ll be glad to see you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what’s on the repair drive and any details I should check first?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s mostly small household fixes and donations—things like lamps, chairs, and basic tools. I’d check that everything is clean, in working order, and labeled with any parts it needs.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—I’ll check that everything is clean, working, and clearly labeled with any missing parts before I pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive—just send me the basics and I’ll skim it quick.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Bo — I’ll send the basics over shortly.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, just keep it short and I’ll take a quick look.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to head over to the repair drive later and bring a few tools if they need them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s awesome, Vik — they’ll definitely appreciate the extra help. I can swing by too and see what else they need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, let’s do that — I’ll head over later with the tools and let you know if I spot anything else they need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered today; what changed?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Nothing big changed — I just wanted to check whether the drive is still happening. I can help if you still need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, it’s still happening — I could definitely use the help. Want to swing by later and we’ll sort it out?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help out with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rey — we could still use a drill, some screwdrivers, and a ladder if you’ve got them. If not, just showing up to help would be a big hand.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring a drill and a couple screwdrivers, and I’ll stop by to help too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking in, Opal — I’m organizing the repair drive list now, and I’d love your help if you’re available. We’re aiming to match each repair with the right volunteer as soon as we can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I can help with that. Send me the repair list, and I’ll match up the locations with the right volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, thank you, Opal — I’m sending the list over now. If you spot any gaps, just let me know and we’ll fill them together.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little worried about the logistics—do we have enough volunteers and a clear drop-off plan?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I can round up a few more neighbors and make sure we set one clear drop-off spot. Let’s keep it simple so nobody gets turned around.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot—if we can keep the drop-off spot obvious, I’ll feel better about people not missing it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet—let me confirm the details before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks—please let me know as soon as you confirm.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep it simple—what’s the plan for the repair drive, and when do you need me there?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m thinking we keep it pretty low-key—just show up, sort the tools, and start with the easy fixes. If you can be there around 9, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Nine works for me. I’ll be there ready to sort the tools and start with the easy fixes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve just heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still keeping an eye on the supply list, but I haven’t heard any big updates yet. If I spot anything useful, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’d appreciate that—I'm mostly hearing scraps, so I’m glad you’re on it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m still meaning to bring by my tools; I just need to check where I left them first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No rush, Oren — just bring them by when you find them. I’ll keep a spot open for your tools.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Mara — I appreciate that. I’ll keep looking and bring them by as soon as I find them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time does the repair drive need us there?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s aim for 9:00 so we’ve got time to set up before classes start.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 9:00 works for me—I’ll plan around drop-off and be there to help set up.
